parameters.deformation: forged along three axes for five times, ~16.7% cumulated height reduction per axis

evidence.quote: sequentially forged along three axes for five times (~16.7% cumulated height reduction imposed for forging on each axis) at room temperature
followed by annealing at 1033 K for 20 min. As such, fine-grained (FG) Al0.1CoCrFeNi HEA specimens with an average grain size of 6.52 μm were obtained.
